description: Block until the session next pauses or ends, then say why and where. Call it after continue_execution (which does not wait) and whenever a tool answers pending:true, instead of polling list_debug_sessions. Answers at once when the session is already paused (state "paused" with lastStop — the same record list_debug_sessions shows — and the top frame as location) or already over (the terminal state, with exitCode when the debuggee reported one); note says when the answer is anchored on a thread other than the one the stop was reported on, or when no frame of the shown stack is program code. If neither happens within the timeout it answers state "running" with pending:true: nothing was cancelled, breakpoints and exception filters stay armed — call it again to keep waiting, or pause_execution to interrupt

timeout.description: Max time (ms) to wait for the stop (default: 30000, max: 600000). Not a limit on the program — it keeps running under the debugger either way. Note: your MCP client may enforce its own overall request timeout; keep this below it and call again on pending:true

name: wait_for_stop
